user.title: Plus Audio Host
user.description: The processor's address on the venue network, and an access token made on it (Settings > Access tokens, staff is enough).

reauth_confirm.title: New access token
reauth_confirm.description: The processor refused the token. Make a new one on it (Settings > Access tokens).

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the processor at that address.
error.not_a_host: That address doesn't answer like a Plus Audio Host.

abort.already_configured: This processor is already set up.

announce.name: Make an announcement
announce.description: Play a saved message, or speak text, in some or all zones.

message.name: Saved message
message.description: Name of a message saved on the processor.

text.name: Text
text.description: Words for the processor to speak (when no saved message is given).

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone names or letters; empty = the zones that take announcements.

chime.name: Chime
chime.description: Play the chime first (default: the processor's setting).

stop_announcements.name: Stop announcements
stop_announcements.description: Stop what's playing and clear the queue.
